spans.s: छित छित. See rt. छो, p. 334.

छित्ति, इस्, f. cutting, division; N. of a tree, =
करञ्ज.

छित्त्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, cutting or fit for cutting (as
a weapon &c.), trenchant; hostile, inimical, a foe;
roguish, fraudulent, knavish, a knave; [cf. छत्-
त्वर and छिदुर.]
छित्त्वा, ind. having cut, amputated, divided.
